g.text: Published Figure 6 targets in the deposited RNA data
Fixed source order; all six libraries retained; no gene-wise significance tests.
Author-selected panels and qPCR targets overlap; each symbol is shown once. Cxcl1 is qPCR-only in the source.
* Below fixed CPM filter or not uniquely mapped; blank = unavailable. Colors are not pathway activity or function.
WT = published WT IL-22; B3 = published 22-B3. Independent animal/preparation keys remain unverified.
